title: Stop exhausting yourself before prayer
summary: The prayer begins where self-rescue has run out: Save me, Father; all virtues are Yours. Let helplessness become honest prayer instead of another performance.
takeaway: Ask to be saved before exhaustion turns into self-display.
lifeApplication: When you are spent, say the need plainly before launching another attempt to prove you can manage it alone.

source.shortMeaning: The cry asks the Father God to save the one without virtue, confessing that every virtue belongs to the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When you are spent, ask for help before starting another rescue attempt.

evidence.coreClaim: Exhaustion becomes prayer when the self stops performing adequacy and asks the Father God to save what has no virtue of its own.
evidence.turn: Call for shelter before fear turns helplessness into another performance.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you are spent, say the need plainly before launching another attempt to prove you can manage it alone.
